metadata.title: Golden Hour Portraiture with Geometric Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, overexposed male portrait featuring a high-key golden glow and minimalist geometric typography in the upper right quadrant.
excludeWhen: heavy textured or distressed backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a male face bathed in intense, warm light, creating a high-key golden atmosphere with significant lens flare. The composition is tightly cropped, focusing on the eyes and nose, with a clean, modern typographic block positioned in the negative space created by the light bloom.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm light source acts as both a background and a compositional divider.
The typography is anchored to the right, balancing the weight of the facial features on the left.
The extreme close-up creates an intimate, immediate connection with the viewer.
The color palette is nearly monochromatic, relying on tonal variations of amber and gold.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame at an extreme scale, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one on the left, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye travels from the subject's gaze on the left across the bridge of the nose to the typographic block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is dominated by a bright, overexposed light bloom that serves as the canvas for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown (shadows in eyes and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (specular highlights and lens flare)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and high saturation in the warm spectrum, with low contrast in the midtones due to light wash.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'p' features a vertical stem that extends significantly below the baseline, acting as a decorative divider.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and case contrast within the same geometric family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating the name from the title
Elongated descender on 'p' as a vertical anchor

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and clean lines.
Classic geometric proportions and sharp points.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a male face, cropped tightly. Apply a heavy golden-hour lighting effect with a strong lens flare coming from the right side, washing out the right third of the image in bright amber and white light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place geometric sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant. Use a thin weight for the top two lines in uppercase, separated by a thin horizontal line from a third line in lowercase. Extend the descender of the 'p' in the third line downward.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting predominantly golden and overexposed?
Is the crop an extreme close-up of the face?
Is the typography right-aligned and geometric?
Is there a horizontal line separating the text blocks?

adjustableVariables: Specific golden hue (from yellow to deep orange)
mustRedesign: Do not use the exact brand name or title from the original
Ensure the horizontal line is a generic graphic element
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the light bloom
Ensure the text is legible against the bright background
Verify the geometric circularity of the 'o' characters
Confirm the extreme close-up crop remains impactful
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up + Golden Hour Flare + Geometric Sans-Serif (Thin) = Intimate Pop Aesthetic
